articles.title: Gemini AI retro saree edits become new viral trend: Here’s a simple guide to create yours
articles.description: Instagram is buzzing with a new viral trend — retro saree AI edits. Using Googles Gemini Nano Banana tool and ChatGPT prompts, users can transform ordinary selfies into 90s Bollywood-style portraits. The edits feature chiffon, black, red, or polka-dotted sarees, moody lighting, and grainy film textures, evoking nostalgia and cinematic drama. Simple to create, the trend lets users experiment with colors, backgrounds, and moods, blending fashion, culture, and AI creativity in a playful, shareable way.
